fiveRules.title: Deterministic over probabilistic
fiveRules.text: When a rule must hold every time (money, identity, compliance), enforce it in code (hooks, gates). Do not rely only on the prompt.

fiveRules.title: Fix the root cause first
fiveRules.text: The best answer is usually the simplest fix at the source (e.g. a better tool description), not a big new component.

fiveRules.title: Explicit over vague
fiveRules.text: Use concrete criteria and examples. 'Be careful' and 'be conservative' do not work.

fiveRules.title: Isolate context
fiveRules.text: Use subagents, forked skills, and new sessions to keep noise out of the main context.

fiveRules.title: Preserve information
fiveRules.text: Keep facts, sources, errors, and uncertainty. Never hide failures. Never invent missing values.

scenarios.title: Customer Support Resolution Agent
scenarios.tests: Tool gates, hooks, escalation, structured handoff, case facts
scenarios.setup: Claude Agent SDK agent with custom MCP tools (get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund, escalate_to_human); targets 80%+ first-contact resolution while knowing when to escalate.

scenarios.title: Code Generation with Claude Code
scenarios.tests: CLAUDE.md, commands, skills, plan mode, iterative refinement
scenarios.setup: Team uses Claude Code for generation, refactoring, debugging and docs with custom slash commands and CLAUDE.md.

scenarios.title: Multi-Agent Research System
scenarios.tests: Coordinator and subagents, context passing, error propagation, provenance
scenarios.setup: Coordinator delegates to web search, document analysis, synthesis and report subagents to produce cited reports.

scenarios.title: Developer Productivity Tools
scenarios.tests: Built-in tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob), MCP servers, codebase exploration
scenarios.setup: Agent SDK tooling to explore unfamiliar codebases, understand legacy systems, generate boilerplate.

scenarios.title: Claude Code in CI/CD
scenarios.tests: -p flag, --output-format json, independent review, false positives
scenarios.setup: Claude Code in a pipeline for automated review, test generation and PR feedback with minimal false positives.

scenarios.title: Structured Data Extraction
scenarios.tests: tool_use + JSON schema, nullable fields, validation-retry, Batches API, human review
scenarios.setup: Extract info from unstructured documents, validate against JSON schemas, handle edge cases, integrate downstream.
